findings.issue: הַמִּשְׁכָּן is a definite common noun (H4908), left as the transliteration mishkán; common nouns stay Spanish.
cuenta narrows פְּקֻדָּה (oversight, charge, visitation, or numbering) to a numerical account.

notes: Other tokens match in conjunction, number, 3ms suffix, and the name Merarí.
